                              "source": [
                                        "from pathlib import Path\n",
                                        "\n",
                                        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
                                        "import pandas as pd\n",
                                        "import seaborn as sns\n",
                                        "\n",
                                        "# Support running from either the project root or notebooks/.\n",
                                        "data_candidates = [Path(\"data/processed/heart_clean.csv\"), Path(\"../data/processed/heart_clean.csv\")]\n",
                                        "data_path = next((path for path in data_candidates if path.is_file()), None)\n",
                                        "if data_path is None:\n",
                                        "    raise FileNotFoundError(\"Run download.py to create data/processed/heart_clean.csv.\")\n",
                                        "\n",
                                        "df = pd.read_csv(data_path)\n",
                                        "if \"target\" not in df.columns or not df[\"target\"].isin([0, 1]).all():\n",
                                        "    raise ValueError(\"Expected a binary target column containing only 0 and 1.\")\n",
                                        "labels = {0: \"No heart disease\", 1: \"Heart disease\"}\n",
                                        "df[\"target_label\"] = df[\"target\"].map(labels)\n",
                                        "data = df.drop(columns=\"target_label\")\n",
                                        "project_root = data_path.resolve().parents[2]\n",
                                        "figure_dir = project_root / \"report\" / \"figures\"\n",
                                        "figure_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n",
                                        "sns.set_theme(style=\"whitegrid\", context=\"notebook\", palette=\"colorblind\")\n",
                                        "\n",
                                        "# Required dataset inspection: preview, dimensions, schema, summary, missingness, and target counts.\n",
                                        "print(\"First five rows:\")\n",
                                        "display(data.head())\n",
                                        "print(f\"Dataset shape: {data.shape}\")\n",
                                        "print(\"Column information:\")\n",
                                        "data.info()\n",
                                        "print(\"Descriptive statistics:\")\n",
                                        "display(data.describe().T.round(2))\n",
                                        "print(\"Missing values by column (count and percentage):\")\n",
                                        "missing_summary = pd.DataFrame({\n",
                                        "    \"Missing values\": data.isna().sum(),\n",
                                        "    \"Missing (%)\": (data.isna().mean() * 100).round(2),\n",
                                        "})\n",
                                        "display(missing_summary)\n",
                                        "\n",
                                        "# The processed file preserves source row order for this 303-record dataset.\n",
                                        "missing_rows = data.index[data.isna().any(axis=1)]\n",
                                        "if len(missing_rows):\n",
                                        "    missing_locations = pd.DataFrame(\n",
                                        "        [\n",
                                        "            {\"Raw data line (1-based)\": int(row_index) + 1, \"Feature\": feature, \"Original marker\": \"?\"}\n",
                                        "            for row_index in missing_rows\n",
                                        "            for feature in data.columns[data.loc[row_index].isna()]\n",
                                        "        ]\n",
                                        "    )\n",
                                        "    print(\"Exact missing-cell locations (line 1 is the first patient record; '?' is the source marker):\")\n",
                                        "    display(missing_locations)\n",
                                        "    affected_records = data.loc[missing_rows, [\"age\", \"ca\", \"thal\", \"target\"]].copy()\n",
                                        "    affected_records.insert(0, \"Raw data line (1-based)\", missing_rows + 1)\n",
                                        "    print(\"Affected patient records (age, missing-value features, and target):\")\n",
                                        "    display(affected_records)\n",
                                        "else:\n",
                                        "    print(\"No missing values found in the processed dataset.\")\n",
                                        "print(\"Target class counts (0 = no disease, 1 = disease):\")\n",
                                        "display(data[\"target\"].value_counts().sort_index().rename(index=labels).rename(\"Patients\").to_frame())\n",
                                        "\n",
                                        "# Labeled histograms for continuous clinical features, split by target class.\n",
                                        "features = [\"age\", \"trestbps\", \"chol\", \"thalach\", \"oldpeak\"]\n",
                                        "feature_labels = {\n",
                                        "    \"age\": \"Age (years)\", \"trestbps\": \"Resting blood pressure (mm Hg)\",\n",
                                        "    \"chol\": \"Serum cholesterol (mg/dL)\", \"thalach\": \"Maximum heart rate (bpm)\",\n",
                                        "    \"oldpeak\": \"ST depression\",\n",
                                        "}\n",
                                        "missing_features = set(features).difference(df.columns)\n",
                                        "if missing_features:\n",
                                        "    raise ValueError(f\"Missing expected features: {sorted(missing_features)}\")\n",
                                        "palette = {\"No heart disease\": \"#4C78A8\", \"Heart disease\": \"#E45756\"}\n",
                                        "fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 9))\n",
                                        "for ax, feature in zip(axes.flat, features):\n",
                                        "    sns.histplot(\n",
                                        "        data=df, x=feature, hue=\"target_label\", hue_order=list(labels.values()),\n",
                                        "        palette=palette, bins=20, element=\"step\", stat=\"count\",\n",
                                        "        common_norm=False, alpha=0.35, ax=ax,\n",
                                        "    )\n",
                                        "    ax.set(title=f\"Distribution of {feature_labels[feature]}\", xlabel=feature_labels[feature], ylabel=\"Number of patients\")\n",
                                        "    ax.grid(axis=\"y\", alpha=0.25)\n",
                                        "axes.flat[-1].set_visible(False)\n",
                                        "fig.suptitle(\"Clinical Feature Distributions by Heart-Disease Class\", fontsize=16, weight=\"bold\")\n",
                                        "fig.tight_layout()\n",
                                        "fig.savefig(figure_dir / \"feature_histograms.png\", dpi=300, bbox_inches=\"tight\")\n",
                                        "plt.show()\n",
                                        "\n",
                                        "# Annotated Pearson-correlation heatmap, including the binary target.\n",
                                        "correlation = data.corr(numeric_only=True)\n",
                                        "correlation_labels = {\n",
                                        "    \"age\": \"Age\", \"sex\": \"Sex\", \"cp\": \"Chest pain\", \"trestbps\": \"Resting BP\",\n",
                                        "    \"chol\": \"Cholesterol\", \"fbs\": \"Fasting glucose\", \"restecg\": \"Resting ECG\",\n",
                                        "    \"thalach\": \"Max heart rate\", \"exang\": \"Exercise angina\", \"oldpeak\": \"ST depression\",\n",
                                        "    \"slope\": \"ST slope\", \"ca\": \"Major vessels\", \"thal\": \"Thalassemia\", \"target\": \"Target\",\n",
                                        "}\n",
                                        "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 11))\n",
                                        "sns.heatmap(\n",
                                        "    correlation, annot=True, fmt=\".2f\", cmap=\"vlag\", center=0, vmin=-1, vmax=1,\n",
                                        "    square=True, linewidths=0.5, cbar_kws={\"label\": \"Pearson correlation\"},\n",
                                        "    xticklabels=[correlation_labels.get(col, col) for col in correlation.columns],\n",
                                        "    yticklabels=[correlation_labels.get(col, col) for col in correlation.columns], ax=ax,\n",
                                        ")\n",
                                        "ax.set_title(\"Feature Correlation Heatmap\", fontsize=16, weight=\"bold\", pad=16)\n",
                                        "ax.set_xlabel(\"Feature\")\n",
                                        "ax.set_ylabel(\"Feature\")\n",
                                        "ax.tick_params(axis=\"x\", labelrotation=45)\n",
                                        "ax.tick_params(axis=\"y\", labelrotation=0)\n",
                                        "fig.tight_layout()\n",
                                        "fig.savefig(figure_dir / \"correlation_heatmap.png\", dpi=300, bbox_inches=\"tight\")\n",
                                        "plt.show()\n",
                                        "\n",
                                        "# Labeled class-balance chart with patient counts and percentages.\n",
                                        "class_order = list(labels.values())\n",
                                        "class_counts = df[\"target_label\"].value_counts().reindex(class_order, fill_value=0)\n",
                                        "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))\n",
                                        "bars = ax.bar(class_order, class_counts.values, color=[palette[label] for label in class_order], width=0.65)\n",
                                        "for bar, label in zip(bars, class_order):\n",
                                        "    count = int(class_counts[label])\n",
                                        "    ax.annotate(\n",
                                        "        f\"{count:,} patients ({count / len(df) * 100:.1f}%)\",\n",
                                        "        (bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, bar.get_height()),\n",
                                        "        xytext=(0, 7), textcoords=\"offset points\", ha=\"center\", va=\"bottom\",\n",
                                        "    )\n",
                                        "ax.set(title=\"Heart-Disease Class Balance\", xlabel=\"Target class\", ylabel=\"Number of patients\")\n",
                                        "ax.set_ylim(0, max(class_counts.max() * 1.18, 1))\n",
                                        "ax.grid(axis=\"y\", alpha=0.25)\n",
                                        "fig.tight_layout()\n",
                                        "fig.savefig(figure_dir / \"class_balance.png\", dpi=300, bbox_inches=\"tight\")\n",
                                        "plt.show()\n",
                                        "\n",
                                        "print(f\"Saved EDA figures to {figure_dir}:\")\n",
                                        "for figure_name in (\"feature_histograms.png\", \"correlation_heatmap.png\", \"class_balance.png\"):\n",
                                        "    print(f\"- {figure_name}\")\n"
                              ]
                    },
                    {
                              "cell_type": "markdown",
                              "id": "6553f19b",
                              "metadata": {},
                              "source": [
                                        "## EDA observations and interpretation\n",
                                        "\n",
                                        "- **Dataset dimensions:** The cleaned Cleveland dataset has **303 patients** and **13 predictor features**, plus the binary `target` column (`0` = no heart disease, `1` = heart disease).\n",
                                        "- **Missing-value audit:** There are **4 missing values in `ca`** (lines 167, 193, 288, 303) and **2 in `thal`** (lines 88, 267); all other columns, including the target, are complete. These predictor rows are retained in the cleaned CSV and imputed using the training-split median inside each scikit-learn model pipeline to prevent data leakage.\n",
                                        "- **Class balance:** Both classes are well representedâ€”**164 patients (54.1%)** are labeled no heart disease (`0`) and **139 patients (45.9%)** are labeled heart disease (`1`). Stratified train/test splitting and stratified 5-fold cross-validation are used during modeling to preserve this ratio.\n",
                                        "- **Feature distributions (Histograms):** Patients with heart disease in this cohort tend to show higher ages (concentrated around 55â€“63 years), lower maximum heart rates (`thalach`), and higher exercise-induced ST depression (`oldpeak`), whereas resting blood pressure (`trestbps`) and serum cholesterol (`chol`) show substantial overlap between classes.\n",
                                        "- **Pairwise associations (Correlation Heatmap):** The strongest linear correlations with `target` are `thal` (**0.53**), `ca` (**0.46**), `exang` (**0.43**), `oldpeak` (**0.42**), `cp` (**0.41**), and `thalach` (**-0.42**). Pairwise correlation is descriptive rather than causal and does not replace cross-validated model evaluation.\n",
                                        "- **Scope limitation:** These patterns describe a small historical cohort (303 records) and several discrete clinical codes (`cp`, `restecg`, `slope`, `ca`, `thal`), so they should not be generalized to clinical practice.\n",
                                        "\n",
                                        "The three figures are saved to `report/figures/feature_histograms.png`, `report/figures/correlation_heatmap.png`, and `report/figures/class_balance.png` for inclusion in the final report."
                              ]
                    }
          ],
